cloudflare.durable_objects.duration.note: Beyond the 400,000 GB-s a month the plan includes; billable usage is rounded up to the next million GB-s, which is not modelled. Read on the pricing page; Cloudflare publishes no price API, so sync cannot recheck it

cloudflare.durable_objects.requests.note: Beyond the 1 million a month the plan includes. HTTP requests, RPC sessions and alarm invocations each count one; incoming WebSocket messages count one per 20. Read on the pricing page; Cloudflare publishes no price API, so sync cannot recheck it

cloudflare.durable_objects.rows_read.note: SQLite backend, beyond the 25 billion a month the plan includes; the same rate as D1. Read on the pricing page; Cloudflare publishes no price API, so sync cannot recheck it

cloudflare.durable_objects.rows_written.note: SQLite backend, beyond the 50 million a month the plan includes; deletes and setAlarm count as rows written. Read on the pricing page; Cloudflare publishes no price API, so sync cannot recheck it

cloudflare.durable_objects.storage.note: SQLite backend, beyond the 5 GB-month the plan includes. Read on the pricing page; Cloudflare publishes no price API, so sync cannot recheck it
